prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Noor Halden after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Product recommendations
client: Tidewater Outfitters
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2022-01
end: 2022-04
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Python
- PyTorch
- implicit
- Redis
- AWS SageMaker
implied_skills:
- personalization
built: Similar items and you-may-also-like carousels trained on 1.2M interactions
  and cached in Redis.
metrics:
- click-through rate +14% in a 4-week A/B test

The review is from: Tidewater Outfitters
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "personalization".
text: Noor did a great job on our product recommendations project. They built similar items and “you-may-also-like” carousels using our interaction data, and the work was straightforward to review and ship. In our 4-week A/B test, click-through rate was up 14%, which was exactly the kind of result we were hoping for. Would hire again.
